title: Panic Transmit website, 2011
lede: Panic’s page for the Mac FTP app Transmit 4, archived May 2011: a photoreal delivery truck, a paper-clipped logo tab, and chrome lettering.
summary: A photoreal truck, a paper clip on the logo, embossed chrome lettering, and photoreal icons.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The archived page may lack some images or scripts that the live page had.

styles.note: Borderline: the objects are fully skeuomorphic (a truck for file transfer, a paper clip on the logo tab, chrome lettering), but the page body is plain light gray with no material texture.

observed: The top band is a dark gradient with a large photoreal yellow and purple truck, the app’s icon.
A white Panic logo tab at the top left is held by a drawn paper clip.
The links Download, Get Help, and Buy Now each have a photoreal icon: a hard disk with a green arrow, a glossy question mark, and a wooden crate.
The word “Features” is set in outlined chrome script with a bevel and shadow.
Below, a screenshot of the Transmit window shows a gray gradient toolbar and red callout dots.
interpretation: Vertical gradients cover 94% of boxes, but no box has a measured shadow and the pattern shares are 0. The page’s depth is in its illustrations.
borrow: Clip the logo to the page with a drawn paper clip, as on a document.
Let one large photoreal object carry the metaphor and keep the text area plain.

images.alt: Archived Transmit page: a dark band with a large photoreal yellow truck with a purple cargo box, a paper-clipped Panic logo tab, Download, Get Help, and Buy Now links with photoreal icons, a blue headline about Transmit 4, chrome Features lettering, and a screenshot of the app window.
images.caption: First viewport of the [archived copy](https://web.archive.org/web/20110531073504/http://www.panic.com/transmit/).
